resolution.note: check() returns [] without src/; regression test RED on base (ENOENT) and GREEN on head; src/.keep workarounds removed

title: Boundary check crashes on a root without src/
body:
Outcome: the import-boundary check returns no violations for a root without src/ instead of throwing ENOENT, so the fast-check worktree test is deterministic.
Evidence: main run 42429658909 (2194438) failed Test (7/10): 'fast check uses the main checkout tools from a worktree without node_modules' crashed in scripts/boundaries.ts walk() with ENOENT scandir <fixture>/wt/src; the fixture repo has no src/, so check() always threw and the test passed only when the tsc stub touched its marker before the process died. Two fast-check fixtures carried src/.keep to dodge the same crash.
Acceptance: check(root) on a root without src/ returns [] (regression test in test/import-boundary.test.ts, RED on base with ENOENT, GREEN on head); the src/.keep fixture workarounds are gone and test/fast-check.test.ts passes.
